items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t remember it at all. ... You lost me.

ctx.x: See, you remember more than I do. I don’t remember. I don’t remember it at all. I remember recording with Carl – singing with Carl, not necessarily recording with him.
It was a studio in Culver City, and the director with the frizzy hair, and Doug Dilge.
